question: What are the three classical categories of Tawhid in Islamic theology?
question_ar: ما هي أقسام التوحيد الثلاثة في العقيدة الإسلامية؟
expected_answer: The three classical categories of Tawhid are: 1) Tawhid al-Rububiyyah (Lordship: affirming Allah alone as Creator, Provider, and Sovereign), 2) Tawhid al-Uluhiyyah (Worship: directing all acts of worship exclusively to Allah), and 3) Tawhid al-Asma wa al-Sifat (Names and Attributes: affirming Allah's divine names and attributes without distortion, negation, or anthropomorphism).
expected_answer_ar: أقسام التوحيد الثلاثة هي: 1) توحيد الربوبية (إفراد الله بأفعاله كالخلق والرزق والتدبير)، 2) توحيد الألوهية (إفراد الله بأفعال العباد من صلاة ودعاء ونسك)، 3) توحيد الأسماء والصفات (إثبات ما أثبته الله لنفسه وما أثبته له رسوله من غير تحريف ولا تعطيل ولا تكييف ولا تمثيل).
key_points: Tawhid al-Rububiyyah: Affirming Allah as the sole Creator, Sustainer, and Controller of the universe.
Tawhid al-Uluhiyyah: Dedicating all acts of worship (prayer, fasting, supplication, sacrifice) solely to Allah.
Tawhid al-Asma wa al-Sifat: Affirming Allah's beautiful names and attributes as revealed without tamthil (resemblance) or ta'til (negation).

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Accurately names and defines all three branches of Tawhid with correct theological distinctions.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What are the six pillars of Iman (faith) mentioned in Hadith Jibreel?
question_ar: ما هي أركان الإيمان الستة المذكورة في حديث جبريل عليه السلام؟
expected_answer: The six pillars of Iman are: 1) Belief in Allah, 2) Belief in His Angels, 3) Belief in His Revealed Books, 4) Belief in His Messengers, 5) Belief in the Last Day (Day of Judgment), and 6) Belief in Divine Decree (al-Qadar), both its good and bad.
expected_answer_ar: أركان الإيمان الستة هي: 1) الإيمان بالله، 2) الإيمان بملائكته، 3) الإيمان بكتبه، 4) الإيمان برسله، 5) الإيمان باليوم الآخر، 6) الإيمان بالقدر خيره وشره.
key_points: Belief in Allah and His Oneness.
Belief in the Angels created from light.
Belief in the Holy Books (Tawrat, Zabur, Injil, Quran).
Belief in all Prophets and Messengers.
Belief in the Day of Resurrection, Judgment, Heaven and Hell.
Belief in al-Qadar (Divine Predestination).

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Lists all 6 pillars in accordance with the Sahih Hadith of Jibreel.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What is the primary role of Angel Jibreel (Gabriel) in Islamic theology?
question_ar: ما هي الوظيفة الأساسية للملك جبريل عليه السلام في العقيدة الإسلامية؟
expected_answer: Angel Jibreel (peace be upon him) is the chief of angels entrusted with conveying Divine Revelation (Wahy) from Allah to the Prophets and Messengers.
expected_answer_ar: الملك جبريل عليه السلام هو الروح الأمين وسيد الملائكة، الموكل بإنزال الوحي من الله تعالى إلى الأنبياء والرسل عليهم الصلاة والسلام.
key_points: Jibreel is known as Ar-Ruh al-Amin (The Trustworthy Spirit).
His primary divine assignment is bringing revelation (Wahy) to prophets.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Identifies Jibreel as the angel of Revelation and the Trustworthy Spirit.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What are the four hierarchical levels (Maratib) of belief in Divine Decree (Al-Qadar)?
question_ar: ما هي مراتب الإيمان بالقدر الأربع في عقيدة أهل السنة والجماعة؟
expected_answer: The four levels of Al-Qadar are: 1) Al-Ilm (Eternal Divine Knowledge of all things before they exist), 2) Al-Kitabah (The Inscription in the Preserved Tablet / Al-Lawh al-Mahfuz), 3) Al-Mashiah (The Divine Will - whatever Allah wills happens and whatever He does not will never happens), and 4) Al-Khalq (The Creation - Allah is the sole Creator of all beings, actions, and occurrences).
expected_answer_ar: مراتب الإيمان بالقدر أربع: 1) العلم (علم الله الأزلي الشامل لكل شيء)، 2) الكتابة (كتابة مقادير كل شيء في اللوح المحفوظ)، 3) المشيئة (مشيئة الله النافذة وإرادته الشاملة فما شاء الله كان وما لم يشأ لم يكن)، 4) الخلق (أن الله خالق كل شيء وخالق أفعال العباد).
key_points: Al-Ilm: Allah's comprehensive, eternal knowledge.
Al-Kitabah: Writing everything in the Preserved Tablet 50,000 years before creation.
Al-Mashiah: All occurrences happen by Allah's absolute Will.
Al-Khalq: Allah is the Creator of all creation and their actions.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Clearly articulates the four levels of Qadar and balances divine sovereignty with human moral responsibility.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What is the foundational rule for understanding Allah's Divine Names and Attributes according to Surah Ash-Shura 42:11?
question_ar: ما هي القاعدة الأساسية في فهم أسماء الله وصفاته استناداً إلى قوله تعالى: (لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ)؟
expected_answer: The foundational rule is 'Laysa ka-mithlihi shay'un wa huwa as-Sami'u al-Basir' (There is nothing like unto Him, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing). It establishes two concurrent principles: 1) Tanzih (absolute transcendence and negation of similarity to creation), and 2) Ithbat (affirmation of the perfect attributes that Allah affirms for Himself without tamthil, takyif, tahrif, or ta'til).
expected_answer_ar: القاعدة الأساسية هي الجمع بين نفي المشابهة وإثبات الصفات: نفي مماثلة المخلوقين (لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ) مع إثبات صفات الكمال لله تعالى كما وصف بها نفسه (وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ) دون تحريف أو تعطيل أو تكييف أو تمثيل.
key_points: Negation of resemblance (Tanzih) based on 'There is nothing like unto Him'.
Affirmation of perfect attributes (Ithbat) based on 'He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing'.
Rejection of anthropomorphism (tamthil) and rejection of stripping divine attributes (ta'til).

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Explains the dual principle of affirming divine attributes while negating similarity to created beings.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What is the difference between Major Shirk (Ash-Shirk Al-Akbar) and Minor Shirk (Ash-Shirk Al-Asghar)?
question_ar: ما هو الفرق بين الشرك الأكبر والشرك الأصغر في الشريعة الإسلامية؟
expected_answer: Major Shirk involves associating partners with Allah in His Lordship, Worship, or Names (such as praying to other than Allah or sacrificing to idols); it expels a person from Islam, nullifies all good deeds, and is not forgiven if died upon without repentance. Minor Shirk includes actions that are pathways to shirk or minor ostentation (Riya') in worship; it does not expel one from the fold of Islam, but is a grave sin that reduces the reward of the specific deed.
expected_answer_ar: الشرك الأكبر يخرج من الملة ويحبط جميع الأعمال ويخلد صاحبه في النار إذا مات عليه دون توبة (كصرف العبادة لغير الله كالذبح والدعاء لغيره). أما الشرك الأصغر فلا يخرج من الملة ولا يحبط كل الأعمال بل يحبط العمل الذي قارنه، وهو من كبائر الذنوب كالرياء اليسير والحلف بغير الله دون تعظيم الخالق.
key_points: Major Shirk removes a person from Islam and nullifies all deeds.
Minor Shirk is a major sin (e.g. slight Riya, swearing by other than Allah) but does not expel from Islam.
Major Shirk is not forgiven if one dies without repentance (Surah An-Nisa 4:48).

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Differentiates legal consequences, theological status, and impact on deeds between major and minor shirk.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What is the life of Al-Barzakh according to Islamic theology?
question_ar: ما هو عالم البرزخ في العقيدة الإسلامية وما الذي يحدث فيه؟
expected_answer: Al-Barzakh is the intermediate realm/state of existence between physical death and the Day of Resurrection (Qiyamah). In this state, the soul experiences either the bliss or punishment of the grave, begins with the questioning by angels Munkar and Nakir regarding one's Lord, religion, and Prophet.
expected_answer_ar: البرزخ هو المرحلة الفاصلة بين الحياة الدنيا ويوم القيامة، تبدأ بعد الموت بسؤال الملكين منكر ونكير عن الرب والدين والنبي، ويكون فيها العبد إما في نعيم القبر أو عذابه إلى أن يبعث الناس ليوم الحساب.
key_points: Barzakh is the barrier/realm between death and resurrection.
Questioning in the grave by angels Munkar and Nakir.
Real experience of bliss (Na'im) or torment (Adhab) of the grave.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Defines Barzakh and correctly identifies the grave questioning and intermediate state.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: Who are the 'Ulul-'Azm (Prophets of Firm Resolve) mentioned in the Quran?
question_ar: من هم أولو العزم من الرسل المذكورون في القرآن الكريم؟
expected_answer: The five Ulul-'Azm (Prophets of Firm Determination) are: 1) Nuh (Noah), 2) Ibrahim (Abraham), 3) Musa (Moses), 4) Isa (Jesus), and 5) Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon them all).
expected_answer_ar: أولو العزم من الرسل خمسة هم: نوح، وإبراهيم، وموسى، وعيسى، ومحمد عليهم أفضل الصلاة وأزكى التسليم.
key_points: Five greatest messengers endowed with extraordinary patience and resolve.
Specifically mentioned together in Surah Al-Ahzab (33:7) and Surah Ash-Shura (42:13).

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Names all five Ulul-'Azm messengers accurately.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What are the two mandatory conditions for accepted Intercession (Ash-Shafa'ah) on the Day of Judgment?
question_ar: ما هما الشرطان الأساسيان لقبول الشفاعة يوم القيامة في القرآن الكريم؟
expected_answer: The two mandatory conditions for accepted intercession (Ash-Shafa'ah al-Muthbatah) are: 1) Permission (Idhn) granted by Allah to the intercessor (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:255), and 2) Allah's Pleasure (Rida) with both the intercessor and the one being interceded for (Surah An-Najm 53:26, Al-Anbiya 21:28).
expected_answer_ar: شرطا الشفاعة المقبولة هما: 1) إذن الله للشافع أن يشفع كما في آية الكرسي (مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ)، 2) رضا الله عن الشافع والمشفوع له كما في قوله تعالى (وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ارْتَضَى).
key_points: Condition 1: Permission of Allah (Idhn).
Condition 2: Pleasure of Allah with the recipient of intercession (Rida).
Intercession cannot benefit an unrepentant polytheist (Mushrik).

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Cites both divine permission and divine pleasure as explicit Quranic prerequisites for Shafa'ah.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: How do classical Sunni schools of theology (Athari, Ash'ari, and Maturidi) approach the interpretation of Allah's attributes?
question_ar: كيف تعاملت المدارس العقدية السنية الكبرى (الأثرية، والأشعرية، والماتُريدية) مع نصوص الصفات الإلهية؟
expected_answer: All three schools affirm Allah's absolute transcendence and non-resemblance to creation (Tanzih). The Athari school affirms the literal meanings as befitting Allah's majesty while delegating the modality (Tafwid al-Kayf) without metaphorical reinterpretation (Ta'wil). The Ash'ari and Maturidi schools practice Tanzih alongside either Tafwid al-Ma'na/Kayf (delegating precise knowledge of reality to Allah) or valid linguistic Ta'wil (figurative interpretation according to classical Arabic idiom to preclude anthropomorphism).
expected_answer_ar: اتفقت المدارس السنية الثلاث على تنزيه الله عن مماثلة الحوادث؛ فالأثرية أثبتت الصفات كما وردت بلا كيف ولا تمثيل ولا تأويل مع تفويض الكيف، بينما جمعت الأشاعرة والماتريدية بين التفويض (تفويض المعنى أو الكيفية مع التنزيه) والتأويل اللغوي السائغ بما يليق بجلال الله لدفع توهم التشبيه.
key_points: Common ground: All Sunni schools agree on Tanzih (negation of similarity to creation).
Athari method: Affirmation of attributes without takyif, tamthil, or ta'wil.
Ash'ari/Maturidi method: Tanzih through either Tafwid or contextual linguistic Ta'wil.

ikhtilaf_details.athari: Affirms attributes without figurative reinterpretation while denying modality (Bila Kayf).
ikhtilaf_details.ashari_maturidi: Employs Tafwid or contextual figurative interpretation (Ta'wil) to safeguard transcendence.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Presents scholarly consensus on Tanzih while respectfully mapping the methodological nuances of each school.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What are the five pillars of Islam according to the famous Hadith of Ibn Umar?
question_ar: ما هي أركان الإسلام الخمسة وفق حديث ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما؟
expected_answer: The five pillars of Islam are: 1) Shahadah (bearing witness that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and Muhammad is His Messenger), 2) Establishing Salah (prayer), 3) Paying Zakat (obligatory charity), 4) Fasting Ramadan, and 5) Performing Hajj to the House of Allah for whoever is able.
expected_answer_ar: بني الإسلام على خمس: شهادة أن لا إله إلا الله وأن محمداً رسول الله، وإقام الصلاة، وإيتاء الزكاة، وصوم رمضان، وحج البيت لمن استطاع إليه سبيلاً.
key_points: Shahadah
Salah
Zakat
Sawm Ramadan
Hajj

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Names all 5 pillars.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: Which divine holy scriptures are explicitly mentioned by name in the Quran?
question_ar: ما هي الكتب السماوية المنزلة المذكورة بأسمائها في القرآن الكريم؟
expected_answer: The revealed scriptures named in the Quran are: 1) The Suhuf (Scrolls) of Ibrahim and Musa, 2) The Tawrat (Torah) revealed to Musa, 3) The Zabur (Psalms) revealed to Dawud, 4) The Injil (Gospel) revealed to Isa, and 5) The Quran revealed to Prophet Muhammad.
expected_answer_ar: الكتب السماوية المذكورة بأسمائها في القرآن هي: صحف إبراهيم وموسى، التوراة لموسى، الزبور لداود، الإنجيل لعيسى، والقرآن لمحمد عليهم الصلاة والسلام.
key_points: Tawrat (Musa)
Zabur (Dawud)
Injil (Isa)
Suhuf (Ibrahim & Musa)
Quran (Muhammad)

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Identifies all 5 revealed texts.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What is the Islamic creed regarding the Finality of Prophethood (Khatam an-Nabiyyin)?
question_ar: ما هو معتقد أهل السنة في ختم النبوة بسيدنا محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم؟
expected_answer: It is a core article of Islamic faith that Prophet Muhammad ﷺ is the final and last Messenger and Prophet of Allah, after whom there will be no new prophet or revelation until the Day of Judgment.
expected_answer_ar: يعتقد المسلمون بإجماع قاطع أن النبي محمداً صلى الله عليه وسلم هو خاتم الأنبياء والمرسلين، فلا نبي بعده ولا شريعة جديدة إلى قيام الساعة.
key_points: Prophet Muhammad is Khatam an-Nabiyyin.
No new prophet after him.
Denial of finality expels from Islam by consensus.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Explains the doctrine of finality.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What are the permissible types of Tawassul (seeking a means of approach to Allah) by consensus?
question_ar: ما هي أنواع التوسل المشروعة بالاتفاق في العقيدة الإسلامية؟
expected_answer: The permissible types of Tawassul by unanimous consensus are: 1) Tawassul through Allah's Names and Attributes, 2) Tawassul through one's own righteous deeds, and 3) Tawassul through the supplication of a living, righteous person present with you.
expected_answer_ar: التوسل المشروع بالاتفاق ثلاثة أنواع: 1) التوسل بأسماء الله وصفاته، 2) التوسل بالعمل الصالح للشخص نفسه، 3) التوسل بدعاء الصالح الحي الحاضر.
key_points: Tawassul by Allah's Names/Attributes.
Tawassul by righteous deeds (like the three men trapped in the cave).
Tawassul by supplication of a living person.

ikhtilaf_details.contested: Tawassul through the person/status of the deceased prophet or righteous is subject to scholarly debate.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Distinguishes agreed from debated forms.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What are the essential conditions for a sincere repentance (Tawbah Nasuh) to be accepted?
question_ar: ما هي شروط التوبة النصوح المقبولة عند علماء الإسلام؟
expected_answer: For sins between a servant and Allah, the conditions are: 1) Immediate cessation of the sin, 2) Sincere remorse (Nadam), and 3) Firm resolve never to return to it. If the sin involves the rights of another human being (Huquq al-Ibad), a 4th condition is required: restoring their rights or seeking their pardon.
expected_answer_ar: شروط التوبة الصادقة: 1) الإقلاع الفوري عن المعصية، 2) الندم على فعلها، 3) العزم الأكيد على عدم العود، 4) رد المظالم إلى أصحابها واستحلالهم إن تعلقت بحق آدمي.
key_points: Immediate cessation
Remorse (Nadam)
Determination not to return
Restoring rights of people if violated

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Lists all 3-4 conditions.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What is the Islamic theological consensus regarding the Scales on the Day of Judgment (Al-Mizan)?
question_ar: ما هو الموقف العقدي الصحيح في مسألة الميزان يوم القيامة؟
expected_answer: In Islamic theology, the Scales on the Day of Judgment (Al-Mizan) is established through clear textual proofs from the Quran and authentic Sunnah, affirming that deeds will be weighed on a real physical scale on the Day of Resurrection.
expected_answer_ar: في العقيدة الإسلامية، ثبتت مسألة الميزان يوم القيامة بالأدلة الشرعية القطعية ومفادها وزن أعمال العباد بميزان حقيقي له كفتان يوم القيامة.
key_points: Textual basis in Quran/Sunnah for the Scales on the Day of Judgment (Al-Mizan).
Rejection of philosophical innovations contrary to authentic sources.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Presents mainstream consensus on the Scales on the Day of Judgment (Al-Mizan).

question: What is the Islamic theological consensus regarding the Inviolability of the Quran from alteration?
question_ar: ما هو الموقف العقدي الصحيح في مسألة حفظ القرآن الكريم من التحريف؟
expected_answer: In Islamic theology, the Inviolability of the Quran from alteration is established through clear textual proofs from the Quran and authentic Sunnah, affirming that Allah has personally guaranteed the eternal preservation of the Quranic text.
expected_answer_ar: في العقيدة الإسلامية، ثبتت مسألة حفظ القرآن الكريم من التحريف بالأدلة الشرعية القطعية ومفادها حفظ الله المتكفل به لكتابه العزيز من أي زيادة أو نقصان.

question: What are the four obligatory acts (Fara'id) of Wudu explicitly mandated in Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:6?
question_ar: ما هي فرائض الوضوء الأربع المنصوص عليها في سورة المائدة (الآية 6)؟
expected_answer: The four obligatory acts of Wudu stated in Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:6 are: 1) Washing the entire face, 2) Washing the arms including the elbows, 3) Wiping over the head, and 4) Washing the feet including the ankles.
expected_answer_ar: فرائض الوضوء الأربع المذكورة في سورة المائدة هي: 1) غسل الوجه، 2) غسل اليدين مع المرفقين، 3) مسح الرأس، 4) غسل الرجلين مع الكعبين.
key_points: Washing the face from hairline to chin and ear to ear.
Washing both arms up to and including elbows.
Wiping the head.
Washing both feet up to and including ankles.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Names all 4 Quranic obligations of Wudu accurately.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What are the essential pre-conditions (Shurut) for the validity of Salah?
question_ar: ما هي شروط صحة الصلاة التي تسبق الدخول فيها؟
expected_answer: The essential conditions of prayer are: 1) Islam and sanity/discernment, 2) Purity from major and minor ritual impurities (Taharah), 3) Purity of body, clothes, and place of prayer from physical impurities (Najasah), 4) Covering the Awrah (nakedness), 5) Entry of the prayer time, and 6) Facing the Qiblah.
expected_answer_ar: شروط صحة الصلاة هي: 1) الإسلام والعقل والتمييز، 2) الطهارة من الحدثين الأصغر والأكبر، 3) طهارة البدن والثوب والمكان من النجاسة، 4) ستر العورة، 5) دخول وقت الصلاة، 6) استقبال القبلة، مع النية.
key_points: Taharah from ritual impurity (Wudu/Ghusl).
Removal of physical filth (Najasah).
Covering Awrah appropriately.
Entry of the valid prayer time.
Facing the direction of the Ka'bah (Qiblah).

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Lists the primary pre-conditions for Salah.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What actions invalidate the fast of Ramadan according to Islamic jurisprudence?
question_ar: ما هي مبطلات الصيام الأساسية في الفقه الإسلامي؟
expected_answer: Actions that invalidate fasting when done intentionally and knowingly are: 1) Eating or drinking intentionally, 2) Sexual intercourse (which also incurs heavy Kaffarah), 3) Intentional induced vomiting, 4) Menstruation (Hayd) or post-partum bleeding (Nifas), 5) Nourishing injections/IV fluids that substitute for food/drink, and 6) Ejaculation caused by deliberate physical stimulation.
expected_answer_ar: مبطلات الصيام عمداً مع العلم والتذكر هي: 1) الأكل والشرب عمداً، 2) الجماع (ويوجب القضاء والكفارة المغلظة)، 3) الاستقاءة عمداً (القيء المتعمد)، 4) خروج دم الحيض والنفاس، 5) الإبر المغذية التي تقوم مقام الطعام والشراب، 6) إنزال المني بشهوة بمباشرة.
key_points: Intentional eating or drinking.
Sexual intercourse during fasting hours.
Deliberate vomiting.
Onset of menstruation or lochia.
Nutritive injections substituting for sustenance.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Specifies valid nullifiers while affirming that forgetful consumption does not invalidate the fast.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What are the eight categories of eligible Zakat recipients enumerated in Surah At-Tawbah 9:60?
question_ar: ما هي مصارف الزكاة الثمانية المنصوص عليها في سورة التوبة (الآية 60)؟
expected_answer: The eight eligible categories for Zakat are: 1) The poor (Al-Fuqara'), 2) The needy (Al-Masakin), 3) Zakat administrators/collectors (Al-Amilina Alayha), 4) Those whose hearts are to be reconciled (Al-Mu'allafati Qulubuhum), 5) Emancipating slaves/captives (Fi ar-Riqab), 6) Those burdened with insolvent debt (Al-Gharimin), 7) In the cause of Allah (Fi Sabilillah), and 8) The stranded traveler (Ibn as-Sabil).
expected_answer_ar: مصارف الزكاة الثمانية في سورة التوبة هي: 1) الفقراء، 2) المساكين، 3) العاملون عليها، 4) المؤلفة قلوبهم، 5) في الرقاب، 6) الغارمون، 7) في سبيل الله، 8) ابن السبيل.
key_points: Strict enumeration in Surah At-Tawbah 9:60.
Fuqara and Masakin (poor and destitute).
Collectors, reconciled hearts, liberating slaves/captives, indebted persons, for the cause of Allah, stranded travelers.

must_not_include: building mosques from general zakat (disputed/disallowed by majority)

question: What are the four foundational pillars (Arkan) of Hajj according to majority classical jurisprudence?
question_ar: ما هي أركان الحج الأربعة الأساسية عند جمهور الفقهاء التي لا يصح الحج إلا بها؟
expected_answer: The four indispensable pillars (Arkan) of Hajj according to the majority of jurists are: 1) Entering the state of Ihram with intention (An-Niyyah), 2) Standing at the plain of Arafah (Wuquf bi-Arafah on 9th Dhul-Hijjah), 3) Tawaf al-Ifadah (circumambulation of the Ka'bah after Arafah), and 4) Sa'i between Safa and Marwah.
expected_answer_ar: أركان الحج الأربعة عند الجمهور هي: 1) الإحرام (النية)، 2) الوقوف بعرفة، 3) طواف الإفاضة، 4) السعي بين الصفا والمروة. وهذه الأركان لا تجبر بدم ويلزم الإتيان بها لصحة الحج.
key_points: Ihram (intention for pilgrimage).
Wuquf at Arafah (the defining pillar: 'Hajj is Arafah').
Tawaf al-Ifadah.
Sa'i between Safa and Marwah.
Pillars cannot be compensated by a sacrifice (Dam); they must be performed.

ikhtilaf_details.hanafi: Considers Arkan as only two: Wuquf at Arafah and the majority of Tawaf al-Ifadah; Ihram is a condition (shart) and Sa'i is a wajib.
ikhtilaf_details.jumhur: Considers all four (Ihram, Arafah, Tawaf al-Ifadah, Sa'i) as Arkan.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Specifies the 4 Arkan and notes the core status of Arafah.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: When is the Prostration of Forgetfulness (Sujud as-Sahw) performed in Salah, and what triggers it?
question_ar: متى يُشرع سجود السهو في الصلاة وما هي أسبابه الموجبة له؟
expected_answer: Sujud as-Sahw consists of two prostrations performed either before or after the Taslim to rectify accidental omissions of an obligatory act (Wajib/Sunnah Mu'akkadah), unintentional additions of a physical prayer action, or unresolved doubt in the number of rak'ahs.
expected_answer_ar: سجود السهو سجدتان قبل السلام أو بعده لجبر خلل طرأ في الصلاة، وأسبابه ثلاثة: الزيادة في الأفعال سهواً، أو النقص بترك واجب، أو الشك في عدد الركعات حيث يبني على اليقين وهو الأقل.
key_points: Triggers: addition (Ziyadah), omission (Nuqsan), or doubt (Shakk).
Consists of two prostrations.
Position: before or after Salam depending on cause/school.

ikhtilaf_details.detail: Madhhabs differ on whether all causes are before or after Salam; Shafi'i places all before, Hanafi places all after, Maliki/Hanbali distinguish based on addition vs omission.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Explains the causes and execution of Sujud as-Sahw.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What are the legitimate excuses that permit performing Tayammum (dry ablution) instead of Wudu/Ghusl?
question_ar: ما هي الأعذار الشرعية المبيحة للتيمم بدلاً من الوضوء أو الغسل؟
expected_answer: Legitimate excuses for Tayammum are: 1) Absence of water after searching, 2) Inability to use water due to severe sickness, injury, or fear of worsening illness, 3) Extreme cold with no means of heating water and fear of harm, or 4) Needing the scarce water available for drinking and life preservation.
expected_answer_ar: يباح التيمم في حالات: 1) انعدام الماء وتعذر الحصول عليه، 2) العجز عن استعماله لمرض أو جرح يخشى تفاقمه، 3) شدة البرد المهلك مع العجز عن تسخينه، 4) الحاجة الماسة للماء للشرب وحفظ النفس.
key_points: Lack of water.
Harm from using water due to disease/wounds.
Severe cold threatening health.
Preserving water for thirst.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Identifies legitimate excuses for dry ablution.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What concessions (Rukhas) are granted to a traveler regarding Salah and Fasting?
question_ar: ما هي الرخص الشرعية الثابتة للمسافر في الصلاة والصيام؟
expected_answer: A traveler meeting the conditions of travel is permitted to: 1) Shorten four-rak'ah obligatory prayers (Dhuhr, Asr, Isha) to two rak'ahs (Qasr), 2) Combine Dhuhr with Asr and Maghrib with Isha (Jam' Taqdim or Jam' Ta'khir), 3) Break the obligatory fast of Ramadan and make up missed days later, and 4) Wipe over leather socks (Khuffayn) for up to three days and nights.
expected_answer_ar: رخص السفر المقررة هي: 1) قصر الصلاة الرباعية إلى ركعتين، 2) الجمع بين الظهر والعصر وبين المغرب والعشاء تقديماً أو تأخيراً، 3) الفطر في رمضان وقضاء الأيام لاحقاً، 4) المسح على الخفين ثلاثة أيام بلياليهن.
key_points: Shortening 4-rakah prayers to 2 (Qasr).
Combining prayers (Jam).
Exemption from fasting with later Qada.
Extended wiping on Khuffayn for 3 days.

ikhtilaf_details.hanafi_qasr: Hanafi school views Qasr as an obligatory ruling (Wajib/Azimah) rather than mere concession.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Describes all standard traveler concessions.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What is Zakat al-Fitr, who is obligated to pay it, and when is its deadline?
question_ar: ما هي زكاة الفطر، وعلى من تجب، وما هو آخر وقت لإخراجها؟
expected_answer: Zakat al-Fitr is an obligatory charity of one Sa' (approx. 2.5-3 kg) of staple food per person at the conclusion of Ramadan. It is obligatory on every Muslim who possesses food beyond their immediate family's basic needs for Eid day. Its deadline is before the Eid prayer; paying it after Eid prayer without valid excuse reduces it to ordinary charity.
expected_answer_ar: زكاة الفطر فريضة فرضها رسول الله صاعاً من طعام عن كل مسلم حر أو عبد ذكر أو أنثى يملك ما يفضل عن قوته وقوت عياله يوم العيد وليلته. وآخر وقت لإخراجها قبل صلاة العيد، فإن أخرجت بعدها كانت صدقة من الصدقات مع الإثم إن أخرها بغير عذر.
key_points: Obligatory on all Muslims with surplus food for Eid day.
Amount: one Sa' of staple food.
Deadline: before Eid prayer.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Defines Zakat al-Fitr, obligations, and deadline.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What is the structure and method of performing the Funeral Prayer (Salat al-Janazah)?
question_ar: ما هي صفة صلاة الجنازة وأركانها وكيفية أدائها؟
expected_answer: Salat al-Janazah is a communal obligation (Fard Kifayah) performed standing with four Takbirs (no Ruku or Sujud): 1) After 1st Takbir: recite Surah Al-Fatihah, 2) After 2nd Takbir: recite blessings upon the Prophet (Salawat Ibrahimiya), 3) After 3rd Takbir: make sincere supplication (Du'a) for the deceased, 4) After 4th Takbir: brief pause/supplication followed by Taslim.
expected_answer_ar: صلاة الجنازة فرض كفاية تؤدى قياماً بلا ركوع ولا سجود بأربع تكبيرات: 1) بعد الأولى يقرأ الفاتحة، 2) بعد الثانية يصلي على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، 3) بعد الثالثة يدعو للميت بالرحمة والمغفرة، 4) بعد الرابعة يدعو ويسلم.
key_points: Four Takbirs while standing.
Al-Fatihah after 1st Takbir.
Salawat after 2nd Takbir.
Du'a for the deceased after 3rd Takbir.
Taslim after 4th Takbir.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Outlines the 4-Takbir structure of Janazah prayer.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What are the established Islamic rulings regarding the Nisab threshold for gold and silver Zakat in worship?
question_ar: ما هي الأحكام الفقهية المعتمدة في مسألة نصاب الذهب والفضة في الزكاة في العبادات؟
expected_answer: In Islamic jurisprudence, the Nisab threshold for gold and silver Zakat is governed by textual evidence from the Sunnah and classical consensus, requiring a Nisab of 85 grams of pure gold (20 Dinars) and 595 grams of pure silver (200 Dirhams) with 2.5% due after one lunar year (Hawl).
expected_answer_ar: في الفقه الإسلامي، تخضع مسألة نصاب الذهب والفضة في الزكاة للأدلة الشرعية وضوابط الفقهاء ومفادها نصاب الذهب 85 غراماً ونصاب الفضة 595 غراماً بنسبة 2.5% بعد مرور الحول القمري.
key_points: Ruling and evidence regarding the Nisab threshold for gold and silver Zakat.
Adherence to prophetic sunnah and classical fiqh conditions.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Presents accurate fiqh ruling for the Nisab threshold for gold and silver Zakat.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What are the established Islamic rulings regarding the Friday Prayer (Salat al-Jumu'ah) requirements in worship?

question: What is the difference between Riba al-Fadl (usury of surplus/exchange) and Riba al-Nasi'ah (usury of delay/debt)?
question_ar: ما هو الفرق بين ربا الفضل وربا النسيئة في الفقه الإسلامي؟
expected_answer: Riba al-Fadl is the unequal exchange of two commodities of the same ribawi genus (e.g. exchanging 10g of gold for 12g of gold hand-to-hand). Riba al-Nasi'ah is the excess or interest charged in exchange for a delay in repayment of a loan or debt, or postponing the exchange of ribawi items.
expected_answer_ar: ربا الفضل هو البيع مع زيادة أحد البدلين المتجانسين من الأموال الربوية يداً بيد (كبيع غرام ذهب بغرامين ذهب). أما ربا النسيئة فهو الزيادة المشروطة في الدين مقابل الأجل والتأخير، أو تأخير قبض أحد البدلين الربويين المتحدين في علة الربا.
key_points: Riba al-Fadl: quantitative inequality in barter exchange of same ribawi commodity.
Riba al-Nasi'ah: interest charged for time extension / delay in debt repayment.
Both forms are categorically prohibited in the Quran and authentic Sunnah.

must_not_include: riba is permissible if interest rate is low
evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Differentiates exchange surplus from debt delay with correct legal terminology.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What constitutes excessive Gharar (uncertainty/hazard) and Maysir (gambling) in commercial transactions?
question_ar: ما هو ضابط الغرر الفاحش والميسر (القمار) المفسد للمعاملات المالية في الفقه الإسلامي؟
expected_answer: Gharar refers to major deceit, ambiguity, or uncertainty regarding the existence, delivery, quantity, or price of the subject matter (e.g. selling fish still in the ocean or unborn livestock). Maysir (gambling) is any zero-sum game or contract where a party's financial gain or loss depends purely on chance with one party winning at the direct loss of the other.
expected_answer_ar: الغرر الفاحش هو الجهالة أو المخاطرة الكبيرة في وجود المعقود عليه أو مقداره أو تسليمه (كبيع السمك في الماء أو الطير في الهواء). والميسر هو كل معاملة يتردد فيها العاقد بين الغنم المحض أو الغرم المحض معتمداً على الحظ والصدفة دون عمل حقيقي.
key_points: Gharar prohibited by the Prophet ﷺ (Sahih Muslim).
Four conditions for Gharar to invalidate a sale: major/excessive, in the primary contract, not needed out of public necessity, affecting the core subject matter.
Maysir involves games of pure chance with financial stakes.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Explains the legal definitions and criteria of Gharar and Maysir.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What are the essential requirements for a valid Murabaha (cost-plus markup) transaction in Islamic banking?
question_ar: ما هي الضوابط الشرعية لصحة عقد المرابحة للآمر بالشراء في المصرفية الإسلامية؟
expected_answer: For a Murabaha contract to be valid: 1) The seller/financier must fully disclose the actual cost of the asset and the agreed markup, 2) The financier must genuinely own and take possession (Qabd) of the asset before selling it to the client, 3) The asset must bear genuine commercial risk (Daman) while in the financier's possession, and 4) The debt repayment price cannot increase if the client defaults or delays payment.
expected_answer_ar: ضوابط المرابحة الشرعية: 1) الإفصاح التام عن ثمن الشراء الأصلي وهامش الربح المعلوم، 2) ملكية المصرف للسلعة وقبضها الحقيقي أو الحكمي قبل إعادة بيعها للعميل، 3) تحمل المصرف لضمان السلعة ومخاطرها قبل تسليمها، 4) عدم فرض فوائد أو زيادات ربوية عند تأخر العميل في سداد الأقساط.
key_points: Full disclosure of cost price and profit markup.
Possession (Qabd) prior to resale.
Bearing liability/risk of loss prior to delivery.
No compounding penalty interest for delayed payments.

must_not_include: selling what one does not own
evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Specifies cost disclosure, prior possession, and risk-bearing as mandatory prerequisites.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: How do Mudaraba (profit-sharing partnership) and Musharaka (equity partnership) allocate capital, management, and financial loss?
question_ar: كيف يوزع رأس المال والإدارة والخسارة المالية في عقدي المضاربة والمشاركة في الفقه الإسلامي؟
expected_answer: In Mudaraba, one party (Rabb al-Mal) provides 100% of the capital while the other (Mudarib) provides 100% of management; profits are shared at an agreed ratio, but financial loss is borne entirely by the capital provider (unless due to Mudarib's negligence), while the Mudarib loses their effort. In Musharaka, all partners contribute capital and have the right to participate in management; profit is distributed by agreement, but financial loss must strictly match the exact proportion of each partner's capital contribution.
expected_answer_ar: في المضاربة: يقدم رب المال كامل التمويل ويقدم المضارب الجهد والإدارة؛ الربح يقتسم بالنسبة المتفق عليها، والخسارة المالية يتحملها صاحب المال وحده (إلا بتعدٍّ أو تفريط من المضارب) ويخسر المضارب جهده. أما في المشاركة: فيقدم كل شريك حصة من رأس المال ويحق للجميع الإدارة؛ الربح يوزع حسب الاتفاق، ولكن الخسارة توزع وجوباً بنسبة رأس مال كل شريك بلا استثناء.
key_points: Mudaraba: Capital from one party, labor/management from the other.
Musharaka: Capital contributed by all partners.
Core Fiqh Rule: Loss is always in proportion to capital (Al-Khasarah ala qadr al-mal).
Negligence (Ta'addi/Tafreet) shifts loss to the manager.

must_not_include: guaranteeing fixed profit percentage on principal
evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Accurately contrasts capital provision, management rights, and loss distribution between Mudaraba and Musharaka.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: Why is conventional commercial insurance impermissible in Islamic jurisprudence, and how does Takaful resolve this?
question_ar: لماذا يحرم التأمين التجاري التقليدي وكيف يقدم التأمين التكافلي الإسلامي بديلاً شرعياً له؟
expected_answer: Conventional insurance is deemed impermissible because it contains three prohibited elements: 1) Major Gharar (uncertainty of payout vs premium), 2) Riba (unequal exchange of money for money with delay), and 3) Maysir (gambling where policyholder gains at insurer's direct loss or vice versa). Takaful resolves this by structuring the system on Tabarru' (mutual charitable donation) and cooperative risk-pooling (Ta'awun), where participants donate contributions into a mutual fund and surplus is refunded rather than kept as insurer profit.
expected_answer_ar: حرم التأمين التجاري لاشتماله على ثلاثة محاذير: الغرر الفاحش، والربا، والقمار. وقدم التكافل الإسلامي بديلاً يقوم على مبدأ التبرع والتعاون المشترك (وَتَعَاوَنُوا عَلَى الْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْوَى) حيث يدفع المشتركون اشتراكاتهم بنية التبرع لصندوق مشترك لتعويض المتضررين، ويعاد الفائض التأميني للمشتركين بدلاً من استئثار الشركة به.
key_points: Three flaws in conventional insurance: Gharar, Riba, and Maysir.
Takaful foundation: Tabarru' (gratuitous contribution) and Ta'awun (mutual solidarity).
Separation between participant risk fund and operator management fund.
Underwriting surplus returned to participants or carried forward.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Explains the 3 classical prohibitions and articulates the Tabarru model of Takaful.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What are the mandatory conditions for a valid Bai' al-Salam (forward sale contract)?
question_ar: ما هي شروط صحة عقد السلم (بيع السلم) في الفقه الإسلامي؟
expected_answer: Bai' al-Salam is an exception to the ban on selling what one does not possess, requiring: 1) Full payment of the purchase price in advance at the time of contract, 2) Exact specification of the generic fungible goods (genus, quality, quantity, weight), 3) Clear predetermined future delivery date, and 4) General availability of the commodity in the market at the promised delivery date.
expected_answer_ar: شروط بيع السلم هي: 1) تسليم رأس مال السلم كاملاً في مجلس العقد، 2) انضباط المسلَم فيه بالوصف والكمية والمقدار مانعاً للجهالة، 3) تحديد أجل معلوم للتسليم، 4) أن يكون المسلَم فيه عام الوجود في السوق عند حلول الأجل.
key_points: Full advance payment at contract signing.
Exact goods specification.
Specified future delivery date.
Goods must be generally available at delivery.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Outlines the essential conditions of Salam.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What is an Istisna' (manufacturing contract) and how does it differ from Bai' al-Salam?
question_ar: ما هو عقد الاستصناع وكيف يفترق عن عقد السلم في الفقه الإسلامي؟
expected_answer: Istisna' is a contract with a manufacturer to produce customized goods from the manufacturer's own materials. Unlike Salam, Istisna' does not strictly require full upfront price payment (payments can be staggered in installments or upon delivery) and specifically applies to manufactured goods rather than agricultural/raw commodities.
expected_answer_ar: الاستصناع عقد شراء عين موصوفة في الذمة مشروطة بالصناعة من مادة الصانع. ويفترق عن السلم بعدم اشتراط تسليم الثمن كاملاً في مجلس العقد بل يجوز تأجيله أو تقسيطه، ويختص بالسلع المصنعة.
key_points: Istisna applies to manufactured/custom goods.
Payment does not have to be 100% upfront.
Materials provided by manufacturer.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Contrasts Istisna with Salam accurately.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What are the essential conditions for a valid Ijara (leasing/hiring) contract?
question_ar: ما هي شروط صحة عقد الإجارة في الفقه الإسلامي؟
expected_answer: For a valid Ijara: 1) The usufruct (Manfa'ah) must be known, lawful (Halal), and deliverable, 2) The rental payment/wage must be clearly specified, 3) The duration of lease must be fixed, and 4) Maintenance of the leased asset's core structure remains the lessor's liability while the lessee bears operational upkeep.
expected_answer_ar: شروط الإجارة: 1) أن تكون المنفعة معلومة ومباحة شرعاً ومقدوراً على استيفائها، 2) أن تكون الأجرة معلومة ومحددة، 3) تحديد مدة الإجارة، 4) تحمل المؤجر لضمان العين وصيانتها الأساسية.
key_points: Lawful and specified usufruct.
Fixed rent/wage.
Defined lease duration.
Structural maintenance on lessor.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Lists essential conditions of leasing in Fiqh.

question: What is the nature of Wadiah (safekeeping deposit) and when does the trustee become liable for loss?
question_ar: ما هي طبيعة عقد الوديعة ومتى يضمن المودَع عنده هلاك العين المودعة؟
expected_answer: Wadiah is a fiduciary trust (Amanah) where the safekeeper holds property for another without liability for accidental damage or destruction, unless the trustee is guilty of willful transgression (Ta'addi) or negligence (Tafreet).
expected_answer_ar: الوديعة أمانة في يد المودَع عنده لا يضمن هلاكها إلا إذا تعدى عليها بالاستعمال غير المأذون أو فرّط في حفظها.
key_points: Wadiah is a trust (Amanah).
No liability for accidental loss.
Liability triggered by negligence (Tafreet) or transgression (Ta'addi).

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Explains Wadiah fiduciary rules.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What is Wakalah (agency) in Islamic law and can an agent charge a fee for services?
question_ar: ما هو عقد الوكالة في الفقه الإسلامي وهل يجوز للوكيل أخذ أجر على وكالته؟
expected_answer: Wakalah is authorizing another person to act on one's behalf in a permissible transaction (buying, selling, representation). It can be gratuitous or remunerated with an agreed service fee (Wakalah bil-Ujrah).
expected_answer_ar: الوكالة إقامة الإنسان غيره مقامه في تصرف جائز شرعاً، وتكون تبرعية أو بأجر معلوم (وكالة بأجر).
key_points: Delegation of lawful authority.
Permissible with or without fee.
Agent must act within authorized limits.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Defines Wakalah and fee permissibility.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What is the classical Islamic legal position regarding the Prohibition of Selling Goods before Taking Physical or Constructive Possession in business and finance?

expected_answer: In Islamic commercial law, the Prohibition of Selling Goods before Taking Physical or Constructive Possession is evaluated based on the principles of mutual consent, avoidance of exploitation, and clarity, requiring that a purchaser cannot resell goods until they have established legal possession (Qabd).

question: What are the essential pillars and conditions for a valid Islamic marriage contract (Nikah)?
question_ar: ما هي الأركان والشروط الأساسية لصحة عقد النكاح في الشريعة الإسلامية؟
expected_answer: The essential pillars and conditions of Nikah are: 1) Mutual consent of both bride and groom free from coercion, 2) The presence of the bride's guardian (Wali), 3) The presence of at least two upright Muslim witnesses, 4) The formal Offer (Ijab) and Acceptance (Qabul), 5) The bridal gift (Mahr) designated for the wife, and 6) Absence of legal impediments (such as prohibited degree of kinship or existing active marriages exceeding limits).
expected_answer_ar: أركان وشروط صحة النكاح هي: 1) رضا الزوجين وخلوهما من الموانع الشرعية، 2) ولي المرأة، 3) شاهدا عدل، 4) الإيجاب والقبول، 5) تسمية المهر (الصداق) كحق خالص للمرأة.
key_points: Mutual consent of bride and groom.
Guardian (Wali) of the bride.
Two reliable Muslim witnesses.
Offer and Acceptance (Ijab wa Qabul).
Mahr (dowry) paid to the bride.
Absence of legal impediments (Mawani').

ikhtilaf_details.hanafi: Permits a sane, adult woman to contract her own marriage without an obliging wali, though a suitable match (Kafa'ah) is considered.
ikhtilaf_details.jumhur: Wali is a mandatory pillar for the validity of the marriage of any woman (Maliki, Shafi'i, Hanbali).

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Names all essential pillars and conditions while noting the classical nuance regarding the Wali.

question: What are the categories of women permanently forbidden for marriage (Mahram) due to lineage (Nasab) and fosterage (Rada'ah) in Surah An-Nisa 4:23?
question_ar: من هن المحرمات من النساء تحريماً مؤبداً بسبب النسب والرضاع كما ورد في سورة النساء (الآية 23)؟
expected_answer: Permanently forbidden due to lineage (Nasab) are 7 categories: 1) Mothers (and grandmothers), 2) Daughters (and granddaughters), 3) Sisters, 4) Paternal aunts (Ammat), 5) Maternal aunts (Khalat), 6) Daughters of brothers (nieces), and 7) Daughters of sisters. By fosterage (Rada'ah), the exact same seven degrees apply (foster mother, foster sister, etc.) according to the Hadith: 'What is made unlawful by lineage is made unlawful by suckling.'
expected_answer_ar: المحرمات بالنسب سبع: الأمهات والجدات، البنات وبنات الأولاد، الأخوات، العمات، الخالات، بنات الأخ، وبنات الأخت. ويحرم من الرضاع نظير ما يحرم من النسب لقوله ﷺ: (يحرم من الرضاع ما يحرم من النسب).
key_points: 7 lineage categories in Surah An-Nisa 4:23.
Suckling (Rada'ah) establishes identical permanent prohibitions under classical conditions (5 satiating feeds in early childhood).
Affinity (Musaharah) also establishes permanent prohibitions (mother-in-law, stepdaughter, etc.).

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Lists the 7 lineage categories and applies the universal rule of fosterage prohibition.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What are the different prescribed waiting periods (Iddah) for a divorced woman, a widowed woman, and a pregnant woman?
question_ar: ما هي عدد وأحكام عدة المرأة في الإسلام (المطلقة ذات الحيض، الآيسة، المتوفى عنها زوجها، والحامل)؟
expected_answer: The prescribed Iddah periods are: 1) Divorced menstruating woman: three menstrual cycles (Quru' - Surah Al-Baqarah 2:228), 2) Divorced non-menstruating woman (post-menopausal or young): three lunar months (Surah At-Talaq 65:4), 3) Widowed woman: four months and ten days (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:234), and 4) Pregnant woman (divorced or widowed): until she gives birth to the child (Surah At-Talaq 65:4). A woman divorced before consummation has no Iddah.
expected_answer_ar: مدد العدة الشرعية هي: 1) المطلقة ذات الحيض: ثلاثة قروء (حيضات أو أطهار)، 2) المطلقة الآيسة أو التي لم تحض: ثلاثة أشهر قمرية، 3) المتوفى عنها زوجها: أربعة أشهر وعشرة أيام، 4) الحامل (مطلقة أو متوفى عنها): تنتهي عدتها بوضع الحمل كاملاً، 5) المطلقة قبل الدخول: لا عدة عليها إجماعاً.
key_points: Divorced menstruating: 3 Quru' (cycles).
Divorced post-menopausal/non-menstruating: 3 months.
Widowed non-pregnant: 4 months and 10 days.
Pregnant (widowed or divorced): until delivery of the child.
Divorced before consummation: zero Iddah.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Accurately specifies all four distinct Iddah durations according to their Quranic proofs.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What are the six fixed Quranic fractional shares (Al-Furud al-Muqaddarah) in Islamic inheritance law?
question_ar: ما هي الفروض المقدرة الستة في كتاب الله تعالى في علم الفرائض والمواريث؟
expected_answer: The six fixed fractional shares specified in the Quran for primary heirs are: 1/2 (One-half), 1/4 (One-fourth), 1/8 (One-eighth), 2/3 (Two-thirds), 1/3 (One-third), and 1/6 (One-sixth). These are detailed primarily in Surah An-Nisa (4:11, 4:12, and 4:176).
expected_answer_ar: الفروض المقدرة في كتاب الله ستة فروض: النصف (1/2)، الربع (1/4)، الثمن (1/8)، والثلثان (2/3)، والثلث (1/3)، والسدس (1/6). وهي مفصلة في آيات المواريث في سورة النساء.
key_points: Six fractions divided into two groups: (1/2, 1/4, 1/8) and (2/3, 1/3, 1/6).
Primary heirs receiving fixed shares are known as Ashab al-Furud.
Remainder of the estate after Furud is inherited by Asabah (residuaries).

question: What are the two major restrictions placed on a testamentary bequest (Wasiyyah) in Islamic law?
question_ar: ما هما القيدان الشرعيان الأساسيان للوصية في الفقه الإسلامي؟
expected_answer: The two primary restrictions on Wasiyyah are: 1) The Maximum One-Third Limit: A bequest cannot exceed one-third (1/3) of the net distributable estate, and 2) No Bequest to a Legal Heir: A bequest cannot be made to anyone who is already entitled to inherit as a legal heir ('No bequest for an heir' / 'La wasiyyata li-warith'), unless all other adult heirs unanimously consent after the testator's death.
expected_answer_ar: القيدان الأساسيان للوصية هما: 1) ألا تزيد الوصية عن ثلث التركة لقوله ﷺ: (الثلث والثلث كثير)، 2) ألا تكون الوصية لوارث لقوله ﷺ: (إن الله قد أعطى كل ذي حق حقه فلا وصية لوارث)، إلا إذا أجازها باقي الورثة الراشدين بعد الموت.
key_points: Restriction 1: Maximum 1/3 of total estate.
Restriction 2: Cannot be made to an existing legal heir.
Purpose: Safeguards the God-ordained shares of heirs from being diminished.

must_not_include: bequest can exceed half of the estate

question: What is the difference between Talaq Sunni (the recommended divorce) and Talaq Bid'i (innovated/prohibited divorce)?
question_ar: ما هو الفرق بين الطلاق السني والطلاق البدعي في الفقه الإسلامي؟
expected_answer: Talaq Sunni is pronouncing a single divorce during a period of purity (Tuhr) in which no marital relations took place, leaving the wife to complete her Iddah calmly. Talaq Bid'i is pronouncing divorce while the woman is menstruating or in a purity period where relations occurred, or issuing three divorces simultaneously in one sitting.
expected_answer_ar: الطلاق السني هو أن يطلق الرجل زوجته طلقة واحدة في طهر لم يجامعها فيه ويتركها حتى تنقضي عدتها. أما الطلاق البدعي فهو إيقاع الطلاق أثناء الحيض أو في طهر جامعها فيه، أو إيقاع الطلاقات الثلاث دفعة واحدة بلفظ واحد.
key_points: Talaq Sunni: one divorce in a clean period without intimacy.
Talaq Bidi: divorce during menses or intimacy, or 3 divorces in one phrase.
Talaq Bidi is sinful across all schools.

ikhtilaf_details.triple_talaq: Hanafi/Maliki/Shafi'i/Hanbali count triple divorce in one phrase as 3 binding divorces with sin, while Ibn Taymiyyah and modern Arab personal status laws count it as 1 single revocable divorce.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Contrasts Sunni and Bidi divorce modes.

question: What is Khul' in Islamic family law and how does it operate?
question_ar: ما هو الخلع في الفقه الإسلامي وما هي آثاره المترتبة عليه؟
expected_answer: Khul' is the dissolution of the marriage contract initiated by the wife by returning the Mahr (or agreed compensation) to the husband when she cannot continue the marital union due to aversion or fear of transgressing Allah's limits. It constitutes an irrevocable separation (Bainah Sughra) where the husband cannot take her back during Iddah without a new contract and Mahr.
expected_answer_ar: الخلع هو فراق الزوجة لزوجها بعوض تبذله له كإرجاع المهر إذا كرهت البقاء معه وخشيت ألا تقيم حدود الله. وهو فرقة بائنة بينونة صغرى لا يملك فيها الزوج الرجعة إلا بعقد ومهر جديدين ورضاها.
key_points: Initiated by the wife with return of Mahr.
Based on the hadith of Jamila bint Salul and Thabit ibn Qays.
Results in irrevocable separation (Bainah Sughra).

question: What are the classical impediments (Mawani') that completely bar a person from inheriting?
question_ar: ما هي موانع الإرث المتفق عليها في الفقه الإسلامي؟
expected_answer: The classical impediments to inheritance are three: 1) Homicide/Killing: The killer never inherits from their victim (Al-Qatil la yarith), 2) Difference of Religion: A Muslim does not inherit from a non-Muslim, nor does a non-Muslim inherit from a Muslim, and 3) Slavery: A slave cannot inherit or pass on inheritance.
expected_answer_ar: موانع الإرث ثلاثة متفق عليها: 1) القتل (القاتل لا يرث من المقتول شيئاً)، 2) اختلاف الدين (لا يرث المسلم الكافر ولا الكافر المسلم)، 3) الرق.
key_points: Killing the deceased (Al-Qatl).
Difference of religion (Ikhtilaf ad-Deen).
Slavery (Ar-Riq).

question: What are the foundational principles of Child Custody (Hadanah) in Islamic jurisprudence?
question_ar: ما هي الضوابط الشرعية لحضانة الأطفال عند افتراق الزوجين؟
expected_answer: Hadanah prioritizes the best religious and physical interests of the child. During early infancy and young childhood, custody belongs primarily to the mother (provided she has not remarried a stranger to the child and remains capable), while the father remains fully responsible for all financial maintenance (Nafaqah) and educational oversight.
expected_answer_ar: الحضانة تدور حول مصلحة المحضون؛ والأم أولى بالحضانة في سن الصغر ما لم تتزوج بأجنبي وتكون أهلاً لذلك، مع بقاء النفقة الواجبة كاملة على الأب وتوليه لولايته الشرعية والتعليمية.
key_points: Child's best interest is paramount.
Mother has initial priority for young child.
Father bears 100% financial maintenance.

question: What are the primary financial and non-financial rights of a wife over her husband in Islamic law?
question_ar: ما هي الحقوق المالية وغير المالية الواجبة للزوجة على زوجها؟
expected_answer: A wife's rights over her husband include: 1) Financial: Prompt payment of Mahr and full living maintenance (Nafaqah covering suitable housing, food, and clothing according to means), 2) Non-financial: Good, kind treatment (Mu'asharah bil-Ma'ruf), equal division of nights if polyamorous, and protection of privacy and dignity.
expected_answer_ar: حقوق الزوجة: 1) مالية: المهر والنفقة الشاملة للمسكن والمأكل والكسوة بالمعروف حسب قدرته، 2) غير مالية: المعاشرة بالمعروف والعدل وحسن الخلق وصيانة كرامتها.
key_points: Mahr.
Nafaqah (housing, food, clothing).
Good treatment (Mu'asharah bil-Ma'ruf).
Justice and fairness.

question: What is the Islamic inheritance ruling for the share of the Husband with and without surviving children under classical Fara'id?
question_ar: ما هو الحكم الفقهي وقسمة الميراث في مسألة ميراث الزوج عند وجود الفرع الوارث وعدمه؟
expected_answer: Under Islamic inheritance law, the share of the Husband with and without surviving children is resolved according to the Quranic fixed shares (Furud) and residuary rules (Tas'eeb), where the husband receives 1/2 of the wife's estate if she leaves no surviving children/grandchildren, and 1/4 if she leaves surviving children.

Application of Hajb (exclusion) and Tas'eeb rules.

question: What is the primary chronological criterion defining Makki and Madani surahs in Quranic sciences?
question_ar: ما هو الضابط الزمني الأساسي المعتمد عند علماء علوم القرآن في التفريق بين السور المكية والمدنية؟
expected_answer: The primary chronological criterion adopted by majority scholars is: Any revelation sent down before the Prophet's Hijrah (migration to Madinah) is Makki (regardless of geographical location), and any revelation sent down after the Hijrah is Madani (even if revealed in Makkah during the Conquest or Farewell Pilgrimage).
expected_answer_ar: الضابط المعتمد عند جمهور العلماء هو الضابط الزمني: فالمكي هو ما نزل قبل الهجرة النبوية إلى المدينة وإن نزل بغير مكة، والمدني هو ما نزل بعد الهجرة النبوية وإن نزل بمكة كعام الفتح أو حجة الوداع.
key_points: Primary standard: Time of revelation relative to the Hijrah.
Pre-Hijrah = Makki.
Post-Hijrah = Madani.
Makki surahs focus primarily on Tawhid, Creed, Resurrection, and Seerah stories; Madani surahs focus on detailed legal rulings, civil laws, family law, and statecraft.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: States the definitive chronological standard (pre vs post Hijrah) and thematic characteristics.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What were the distinct historical roles of Caliph Abu Bakr as-Siddiq and Caliph Uthman ibn Affan in the compilation and preservation of the Quran?
question_ar: ما هو الفرق بين جمع القرآن الكريم في عهد الخليفة أبي بكر الصديق وجمعه في عهد الخليفة عثمان بن عفان رضي الله عنهما؟
expected_answer: Under Abu Bakr (prompted by Umar after the Battle of Yamama where many Huffaz were martyred), the scattered written Quranic fragments were collected into a single consolidated manuscript (Suhuf) kept in verified order. Under Uthman, due to differing regional dialect recitations causing disputes across expanding territories, the text was transcribed into standardized official copies (Mushaf Uthmani) based on the Quraishi dialect, distributed to regional capitals, and all conflicting idiosyncratic private manuscripts were destroyed.
expected_answer_ar: جمع أبي بكر كان جمعاً لآيات القرآن المكتوبة المتفرقة وتدوينها في مصحف واحد (الصحف) بعد استشهاد عدد كبير من الحفاظ في معركة اليمامة. أما جمع عثمان فكان استنساخاً لمصاحف موحدة وتوحيداً للأمة على رسم المصحف العثماني بلسان قريش ودفعاً للاختلاف والتنازع في القراءة، مع إرسال نسخ للأمصار وحرق ما عداها.
key_points: Abu Bakr: Initial compilation into a single volume (Suhuf) overseen by Zaid ibn Thabit.
Trigger under Abu Bakr: Martyrdom of memorizers at Yamamah.
Uthman: Standardization of the official script (Rasm Uthmani) in the Quraishi dialect.
Trigger under Uthman: Regional disputes over pronunciation and recitation during the conquest of Armenia/Azerbaijan.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Accurately contrasts Abu Bakr's consolidation with Uthman's standardization and regional distribution.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What is the relationship between the 'Seven Ahruf' (modes of revelation) and the 'Ten Qira'at' (canonical recitations) in Quranic scholarship?
question_ar: ما هي العلاقة والفرق بين الأحرف السبعة التي نزل بها القرآن الكريم والقراءات العشر المتواترة؟
expected_answer: The Seven Ahruf refers to the divine facilitations and dialectical/linguistic variations in which the Quran was revealed to ease recitation across diverse Arab tribes. The Ten Qira'at are the authentic, mutawatir transmission traditions (recitation methods) documented by master reciters (such as Nafi', Asim, Ibn Kathir, Abu Amr) that all fit within the unified skeletal orthography (Rasm) of the Uthmanic Mushaf.
expected_answer_ar: الأحرف السبعة هي التوسعة الإلهية والوجوه واللغات التي نزل بها القرآن للتيسير على قبائل العرب. والقراءات العشر هي مذاهب الأئمة القراء المتواترة (كنافع وعاصم وابن كثير وأبي عمرو) التي تواترت أسانيدها إلى رسول الله ﷺ، وجميعها محتومة بما يحتمله رسم المصحف العثماني من تلك الأحرف.
key_points: Hadith: 'The Quran was revealed in seven Ahruf' (Bukhari/Muslim).
Ahruf are divine dialectic/linguistic facilitations.
Qira'at are historical, mutawatir recitation schools conforming to Rasm Uthmani and Arabic grammar.
Qira'at are not simply the seven Ahruf; they represent the preserved aspects of Ahruf accommodating the Uthmanic text.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Distinguishes the seven Ahruf of revelation from the ten historical Qira'at transmission schools.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What is the recognized hierarchy of sources in classical Tafsir (Tafsir bil-Ma'thur)?
question_ar: ما هي المراتب المعتمدة في منهج التفسير بالمأثور عند الإمام ابن كثير وأهل العلم؟
expected_answer: The authoritative hierarchy of Tafsir sources is: 1) Tafsir of the Quran by the Quran (interpreting verses with corresponding verses), 2) Tafsir of the Quran by the Sunnah (prophetic explanations and applications), 3) Tafsir by the Statements of the Sahabah (Companions who witnessed the revelation, like Ibn Abbas and Ibn Mas'ud), 4) Tafsir by the Statements of the Tabi'un (Successors like Mujahid and Qatadah), and 5) Linguistic interpretation according to classical Arabic idiom without contradicting established texts.
expected_answer_ar: مراتب التفسير بالمأثور هي: 1) تفسير القرآن بالقرآن، 2) تفسير القرآن بالسنة النبوية الصحيحة، 3) تفسير القرآن بأقوال الصحابة الكرام (كابن عباس وابن مسعود)، 4) تفسير القرآن بأقوال التابعين (كمجاهد وقتادة)، 5) دلالة لغة العرب وأساليبها الفصيحة مع مراعاة السياق الشرعي.
key_points: Tier 1: Quran by Quran (clearest interpretation).
Tier 2: Quran by authentic Sunnah.
Tier 3: Statements of the Sahabah (especially Turjuman al-Quran Ibn Abbas).
Tier 4: Statements of senior Tabi'un.
Tier 5: Sound Arabic lexicon and syntax.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Enumerates the 5-tiered hierarchy of classical exegesis in correct pedagogical order.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What are the three classical categories of Naskh (abrogation) in Quranic sciences?
question_ar: ما هي أقسام النسخ الثلاثة في علوم القرآن الكريم من حيث بقاء التلاوة والحكم؟
expected_answer: The three classical categories of Naskh are: 1) Abrogation of both the recitation and the ruling (Naskh at-Tilawah wal-Hukm), 2) Abrogation of the ruling while the recitation remains in the Mus'haf (Naskh al-Hukm duna at-Tilawah - the most common type, such as the verse of 1-year widow maintenance abrogated by the 4-month-10-day verse), and 3) Abrogation of the recitation while the legal ruling remains operational (Naskh at-Tilawah duna al-Hukm - such as the stoning verse for married adulterers).
expected_answer_ar: أقسام النسخ ثلاثة: 1) نسخ الحكم والتلاوة معاً، 2) نسخ الحكم مع بقاء التلاوة في المصحف (وهو الأكثر كآية وصية الحول للزوجات المنسوخة بآية أربعة أشهر وعشراً)، 3) نسخ التلاوة مع بقاء الحكم معمولاً به شرعاً (كرجم الثيب الزاني).
key_points: 1. Recitation and ruling both abrogated.
2. Ruling abrogated while recitation is preserved in the Mus'haf (most frequent).
3. Recitation removed while legal ruling remains established in Shariah.
Affirms divine wisdom in gradual legislation (Tadrij).

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Accurately categorizes all 3 permutations of Naskh regarding Tilawah and Hukm.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What is the definition and legal importance of Asbab al-Nuzul (Occasions of Revelation) in Quranic exegesis?
question_ar: ما هو تعريف علم أسباب النزول وما هي أهميته الفقهية والتفسيرية في فهم القرآن؟
expected_answer: Asbab al-Nuzul is the science that studies the direct historical events, questions, or specific circumstances during the prophetic era that coincided with the revelation of specific verses. Understanding the occasion of revelation removes ambiguity, clarifies legislative intent, and identifies whether a ruling is general or context-specific.
expected_answer_ar: علم أسباب النزول هو العلم الذي يبين الوقائع والأحداث أو الأسئلة التي نزلت الآيات القرآنية بشأنها وقت وقوعها. وتكمن أهميته في معرفة وجه الحكمة التشريعية ودفع التوهم وتوضيح المعنى المراد.
key_points: Historical events prompting revelation.
Clarifies legislative rationale and context.
Primary scholars: Al-Wahidi, Al-Suyuti.

question: What is the difference between Muhkam (clear/decisive) and Mutashabih (allegorical/unspecific) verses in Surah Ali 'Imran 3:7?
question_ar: ما هو الفرق بين الآيات المحكمات والآيات المتشابهات في سورة آل عمران (الآية 7)؟
expected_answer: Muhkam verses are clear in meaning, unambiguous, and form the foundational core of the Book (Umm al-Kitab) upon which legal rulings are built. Mutashabih verses have subtle, multifaceted, or allegorical meanings (such as disjointed letters or precise knowledge of the Hour) that must be understood in light of the clear Muhkam verses.
expected_answer_ar: الآيات المحكمة هي الواضحة الدلالة الجلية المعنى التي لا تحتمل التأويل وهي أصل الكتاب وأساس الأحكام. أما المتشابهات فهي ما احتمل أكثر من وجه أو استأثر الله بعلمه الدقيق كفواتح السور، والواجب رد المتشابه إلى المحكم.
key_points: Muhkam: Unambiguous, clear meaning, foundational.
Mutashabih: Multifaceted/allegorical, must be referred back to Muhkam.
Warning against following Mutashabih to seek discord.

question: What is the concept of I'jaz al-Quran (Inimitability of the Quran) and the Quranic Challenge (Tahaddi)?
question_ar: ما هو مفهوم إعجاز القرآن الكريم والتحدي القرآني لعرب الجاهلية والإنسانية؟
expected_answer: I'jaz al-Quran refers to the miraculous inimitability of the Quran in its eloquence, rhetoric, legislative perfection, unseen prophecies, and scientific coherence. The Quran challenged the masters of Arabic eloquence in three progressive stages: to produce an entire book like it, then ten chapters (Surahs), and finally a single Surah like it, which humanity failed to match.
expected_answer_ar: إعجاز القرآن هو عجز البشر مجتمعين عن الإتيان بمثله في بلاغته ونظمه وتشريعه وأخباره الغيبية. وقد تحداهم القرآن على مراحل: بمثله كله، ثم بعشر سور، ثم بسورة واحدة فعجزوا رغم فصاحتهم وبلاغتهم.
key_points: Inimitability of language, style, legislation, and prophecies.
Three stages of Tahaddi: whole Quran, 10 surahs, 1 surah.
Surah Al-Baqarah 2:23-24, Surah Al-Isra 17:88.

question: What distinguishes the classical Tafsir of Imam al-Tabari (Jami al-Bayan) from the Tafsir of Imam Ibn Kathir?
question_ar: ما الذي يميز تفسير الإمام الطبري (جامع البيان) عن تفسير الحافظ ابن كثير (تفسير القرآن العظيم)؟
expected_answer: Al-Tabari's Tafsir is the foundational encyclopedia of early exegesis, compiling full Isnad chains for every statement from Sahabah and Tabi'un, engaging deeply in Arabic grammar, dialect variations, and legal analysis. Ibn Kathir's Tafsir condensed and evaluated these narrations, heavily prioritizing interpreting Quran by Quran and authentic Sunnah, and famously critiquing unverified Isra'iliyyat (Judeo-Christian narratives).
expected_answer_ar: تفسير الطبري هو المرجع الأول للتفسير بالمأثور بأسانيده الكاملة مع الترجيح اللغوي والنحوي الدقيق. بينما تميز تفسير ابن كثير بتهذيب الأسانيد والتركيز على تفسير القرآن بالقرآن وبالسنة الصحيحة ونقد ونبذ الإسرائيليات الضعيفة.
key_points: Tabari: Full isnads, comprehensive linguistic and juristic analysis.
Ibn Kathir: Focused on Quran-by-Quran, authentic hadith, and filtering Isra'iliyyat.
Both represent the pinnacle of Tafsir bil-Ma'thur.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Contrasts Tabari and Ibn Kathir exegeses accurately.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What is the classical scholarly categorization of Isra'iliyyat (Judeo-Christian biblical narratives) in Tafsir literature?
question_ar: ما هي أقسام الإسرائيليات الثلاثة في كتب التفسير وموقف الشرع من كل قسم؟
expected_answer: Classical scholars (like Ibn Kathir and Ibn Taymiyyah) categorize Isra'iliyyat into three types: 1) What conforms to Islamic revelation: Accepted as true and confirming, 2) What contradicts Islamic revelation: Rejected as false and fabricated, and 3) What is neither confirmed nor contradicted: Neither believed nor disbelieved, but narrated solely for historical curiosity without establishing religious dogma or legal rulings.
expected_answer_ar: تنقسم الإسرائيليات إلى ثلاثة أقسام: 1) ما وافق شرعنا فهو صحيح مقبول، 2) ما خالف شرعنا فهو باطل مردود، 3) ما سكت عنه شرعنا فلا نصدقه ولا نكذبه ويجوز روايته للاستشهاد دون بناء عقيدة أو حكم عليه لقوله ﷺ: (حدثوا عن بني إسرائيل ولا حرج).
key_points: Type 1: Conforms to Quran/Sunnah (Accepted).
Type 2: Contradicts Quran/Sunnah (Rejected).
Type 3: Neutral/unverifiable (Neither affirmed nor denied).

question: What are the five mandatory conditions for a Hadith to be classified as Sahih (Authentic)?
question_ar: ما هي شروط الحديث الصحيح الخمسة المتفق عليها عند علماء مصطلح الحديث؟
expected_answer: The five conditions for a Hadith to be Sahih are: 1) Continuous Isnad (Ittisal al-Sanad - unbroken chain of transmission from beginning to end), 2) Moral Integrity of Narrators ('Adalat al-Ruwat - piety, truthfulness, and reliability), 3) Precise Retention (Dabt al-Ruwat - excellent memory or accurate preservation of written records), 4) Absence of Irregularity ('Adam al-Shudhudh - not contradicting a more reliable narrator), and 5) Absence of Hidden Defects ('Adam al-'Illah al-Qadihah - free from subtle flaws that undermine authenticity).
expected_answer_ar: شروط الحديث الصحيح خمسة: 1) اتصال السند، 2) عدالة الرواة، 3) تمام الضبط (حفظ الصدر أو حفظ الكتاب)، 4) السلامة من الشذوذ، 5) السلامة من العلة القادحة الخفية.
key_points: 1. Ittisal al-Sanad (continuous chain).
2. Adalah (moral and religious integrity).
3. Dabt (exact precision in transmission).
4. Free from Shudhudh (irregular contradiction).
5. Free from Illah (hidden disparaging defects).

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Names and defines all 5 conditions without omission.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What is the distinction between Hadith Mutawatir (mass-transmitted) and Hadith Ahad (solitary/non-mutawatir)?
question_ar: ما هو الفرق بين الحديث المتواتر وحديث الآحاد في علم مصطلح الحديث وأثرهما في إفادة العلم والعمل؟
expected_answer: Hadith Mutawatir is a narration transmitted by such a large number of reliable narrators in every generation that it is impossible for them to have colluded on a lie; it imparts definitive certainty (Ilm Qat'i / Yaqini) without needing biographical investigation of individuals. Hadith Ahad is any narration that does not meet the conditions of Tawatur (including Gharib, Aziz, and Mashhur); it imparts probable knowledge (Zanni) and is subject to authentication, but when verified as Sahih or Hasan, it is binding in practice and creed according to Ahl as-Sunnah.
expected_answer_ar: الحديث المتواتر هو ما رواه جمع غفير تحيل العادة تواطؤهم على الكذب عن مثلهم من أول السند إلى منتهاه؛ ويفيد العلم اليقيني القطعي الضروري. وحديث الآحاد هو ما لم يجمع شروط التواتر (ويشمل الغريب والعزيز والمشهور)؛ ويفيد الظن الراجح ويلزم العمل به واعتقاد ما فيه متى صح أو حسن.
key_points: Mutawatir: Massive number of narrators in every tier preventing collusion on falsehood.
Mutawatir yields definitive certainty (Ilm Qati).
Ahad: Narrations below mutawatir threshold (Gharib, Aziz, Mashhur).
Authentic Ahad hadiths are legally binding for practice and creed according to majority scholars.

must_not_include: ahad hadiths cannot be accepted at all
evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Contrasts transmission density, epistemic value, and legal authority between Mutawatir and Ahad.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What is the difference between a Hadith Mursal and a Hadith Munqati'?
question_ar: ما هو الفرق بين الحديث المرسل والحديث المنقطع في أسباب انقطاع السند؟
expected_answer: A Hadith Mursal is specifically a narration where a Tabi'i (Successor) narrates directly from the Prophet ﷺ, omitting the Sahabi (Companion) intermediary from the chain. A Hadith Munqati' is a narration with a broken chain where one or more non-consecutive narrators are missing anywhere else in the middle or end of the isnad.
expected_answer_ar: الحديث المرسل هو ما سقط من آخر سنده من بعد التابعي (أي ما رفعه التابعي مباشرة إلى رسول الله ﷺ مسقطاً الصحابي). أما المنقطع فهو ما سقط من رواته راوٍ واحد في أي موضع من أثناء السند دون توالٍ.
key_points: Mursal: Drop at the end of the isnad where a Tabi'i quotes the Prophet directly.
Munqati': Break occurring anywhere in the middle of the isnad (single missing link).
Mu'dal (two consecutive missing narrators) and Mu'allaq (missing at start of chain) are distinct related categories.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Precisely locates where the missing link occurs in Mursal vs Munqati chains.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What is the fundamental rule when a narrator has both Jarh (disparagement) and Ta'dil (praise) by hadith critics?
question_ar: ما هي القاعدة المعتمدة عند تعارض الجرح والتعديل في الراوي الواحد عند علماء الحديث؟
expected_answer: The foundational rule is: 'Al-Jarh al-Mufassar yuqaddamu ala al-Ta'dil' (Substantiated, detailed disparagement takes precedence over general praise). If a critic specifies a concrete reason for weakness (such as fabrication, poor memory in old age, or hearing from written notes not memorized), it explains what the praising scholar was unaware of. However, if the Jarh is vague/unsubstantiated (Mubham) and the narrator has established Ta'dil, the Ta'dil remains prevailing.
expected_answer_ar: القاعدة الأساسية هي: (الجرح المفسر مقدّم على التعديل)؛ لأن الجارح معه زيادة علم خفيت على المعدل. ولكن إذا كان الجرح مبهماً غير مفسر السبب وعارضه تعديل معتبر من أئمة النقد، فإن التعديل يقدم ويبقى الراوي على عدالته وضبطه.
key_points: Rule: Detailed/explained Jarh (Mufassar) takes precedence over general Ta'dil.
Reason: The disparager possesses specific knowledge of a defect unknown to the praiser.
Unexplained/vague criticism (Jarh Mubham) does not overturn verified praise.
Personal or sectarian bias must be screened out (Mu'asarah).

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Articulates the primacy of explained Jarh over general Ta'dil and conditions for accepting criticism.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What are the Al-Kutub al-Sittah (Six Canonical Hadith Books) and who are their authors?
question_ar: ما هي الكتب الستة المعتمدة في أمهات كتب الحديث ومن هم مؤلفوها؟
expected_answer: The Six Canonical Books of Hadith are: 1) Sahih al-Bukhari (Imam Muhammad ibn Isma'il al-Bukhari), 2) Sahih Muslim (Imam Muslim ibn al-Hajjaj), 3) Sunan Abi Dawud (Imam Abu Dawud al-Sijistani), 4) Jami' at-Tirmidhi (Imam Abu Isa at-Tirmidhi), 5) Sunan an-Nasa'i / Al-Mujtaba (Imam Ahmad ibn Shu'ayb an-Nasa'i), and 6) Sunan Ibn Majah (Imam Muhammad ibn Majah al-Qazwini).
expected_answer_ar: الكتب الستة وأصحابها هم: 1) صحيح البخاري (الإمام محمد بن إسماعيل البخاري)، 2) صحيح مسلم (الإمام مسلم بن الحجاج النيسابوري)، 3) سنن أبي داود (الإمام أبو داود السجستاني)، 4) جامع الترمذي (الإمام أبو عيسى الترمذي)، 5) سنن النسائي (الإمام أحمد بن شعيب النسائي)، 6) سنن ابن ماجه (الإمام محمد بن ماجه القزويني).
key_points: Bukhari and Muslim (The Two Sahihs - highest authenticity).
The Four Sunan: Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi, Nasa'i, Ibn Majah.
Names and authors accurately matched.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Names all six books and their corresponding compilers without error.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What is the difference between Hadith Marfu', Hadith Mawquf, and Hadith Maqtu'?
question_ar: ما هو الفرق بين الحديث المرفوع والموقوف والمقطوع بحسب منتهاه؟
expected_answer: A Hadith Marfu' is attributed directly to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ (words, actions, or tacit approval). A Hadith Mawquf is attributed to a Sahabi (Companion) without being raised to the Prophet. A Hadith Maqtu' is attributed to a Tabi'i (Successor) or someone after them.
expected_answer_ar: الحديث المرفوع: ما أضيف إلى النبي ﷺ من قول أو فعل أو تقرير أو صفة. والموقوف: ما أضيف إلى الصحابي ولم يتجاوز به إلى النبي. والمقطوع: ما أضيف إلى التابعي فمن دونه من أقوالهم وأفعالهم.
key_points: Marfu: Attributed to the Prophet.
Mawquf: Attributed to a Companion.
Maqtu: Attributed to a Successor (Tabii).

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Contrasts the three endpoint categories of narrations.
evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What is a Hadith Hasan (Good) and how does it differ from Sahih?
question_ar: ما هو الحديث الحسن لذاته وما الذي يميزه عن الحديث الصحيح؟
expected_answer: A Hadith Hasan li-Dhatihi meets all five conditions of a Sahih Hadith (continuous isnad, righteous narrators, free from shudhudh and illah) except that the retention/precision (Dabt) of one or more narrators is slightly lighter or inferior to the supreme standard of Sahih narrators.
expected_answer_ar: الحديث الحسن لذاته هو ما اتصل سنده بنقل عدل خف ضبطه عن مثله إلى منتهاه من غير شذوذ ولا علة قادحة؛ فيفترق عن الصحيح في خفة ضبط الراوي مع بقاء عدالته.
key_points: Meets all conditions of Sahih except lighter precision (Khaffat al-Dabt).
Legally binding in rulings and creed.
Elevated to Sahih li-Ghayrihi with corroborating routes.

question: What is a Hadith Mawdu' (Fabricated) and what are the motives behind hadith fabrications?
question_ar: ما هو الحديث الموضوع وما هي الدوافع التاريخية لظهور وضع الحديث والكذب على رسول الله؟
expected_answer: A Hadith Mawdu' is a lie and forgery falsely attributed to the Prophet ﷺ; it is the worst category of rejected narrations and strictly forbidden to narrate except when exposing its fabrication. Historical motives included: political and sectarian partisanship, heretical subversion (Zandaqah), misguided asceticism to encourage good deeds without knowledge, and seeking court favor or financial gain.
expected_answer_ar: الحديث الموضوع هو المختلق المكذوب على رسول الله ﷺ وهو شر الضعيف وتحرم روايته إلا مقروناً ببيان وضعه. ودوافعه التاريخية: التعصب المذهبي والسياسي، والزندقة، والترغيب والترهيب بجهل، والتقرب للحكام والتكسب بالقصص.
key_points: Mawdu is a deliberate fabrication/forgery.
Strictly forbidden to narrate without exposing it.
Motives: Sectarianism, subversion, misguided preaching, commercial gain.

evaluation_criteria.adab_rubric: Maintain reverent tone and respect for sacred texts.

question: What is Ilm al-Takhrij (Hadith Extraction and Sourcing) in Islamic scholarship?
question_ar: ما هو علم التخريج ودراسة الأسانيد وما هي طرقه الأساسية؟
expected_answer: Ilm al-Takhrij is the science of locating original hadith narrations in primary classical sources with their full isnads, identifying their transmission variants, and critically evaluating their authenticity. Methods include searching by the first words of the text (Matn), by a prominent narrator, by subject/fiqh topic, or by distinctive keywords.
expected_answer_ar: علم التخريج هو الدلالة على موضع الحديث في مصادره الأصلية المسندة مع بيان درجته صحة وضعفاً. وطرقه: التخريج عن طريق الراوي الأعلى، أو بأول لفظ من المتن، أو بلفظ مميز، أو بالموضوع الفقهي، أو بالنظر في صفات السند والمتن.
key_points: Locating hadiths in primary source collections.
Tracing isnad variants and chains.
Evaluating overall legal and technical grade.

question: What distinct methodological criteria set Sahih al-Bukhari apart from Sahih Muslim regarding transmission continuity?
question_ar: ما هو الفارق المنهجي الدقيق بين الإمام البخاري والإمام مسلم في اشتراط اللقاء المعاصر؟
expected_answer: Imam al-Bukhari required proven historical face-to-face meeting (Thubut al-Liqa') between the narrator and their teacher for a chain using contemporary 'An'anah to be accepted as connected. Imam Muslim accepted contemporary coexistence (Mu'asarah) during the same lifespan along with possibility of meeting (Imkan al-Liqa'), unless the narrator was guilty of deception (Tadlis).
expected_answer_ar: يشترط الإمام البخاري ثبوت اللقاء المباشر ولو مرة واحدة بين الراوي وشيخه لصحة السند المعنعن. بينما اكتفى الإمام مسلم بمجرد المعاصرة وإمكان اللقاء مع السلامة من التدليس، وهو ما جعل شرط البخاري أشد وأعلى توثيقاً.
key_points: Bukhari requires proven meeting (Thubut al-Liqa).
Muslim accepts contemporaneity (Mu'asarah) and possibility of meeting (Imkan al-Liqa).
Bukhari's condition is higher in strictness.

evaluation_criteria.accuracy_rubric: Contrasts Bukhari's Thubut al-Liqa with Muslim's Mu'asarah.
